## Effect of leaf age on T50 (Hot tolerance)

```{r}
#| label: Create-data-May-old-young

TTHot_wide_old_young <- TTHot_wide_plant |>
  filter(month %in% c("May")) |>
  filter(metric %in% c("T50"))
```

```{r}
#| label: LM-May-old-young
#| fig-height: 10

modele_lm_2 <- lm(estimate ~ leaf_age * age_class, data = TTHot_wide_old_young)
performance::check_model(modele_lm_2)

summary(modele_lm_2)

print(Anova(modele_lm_2, type = "II"))

emmeans(modele_lm_2, ~ leaf_age)
pairs(emmeans(modele_lm_2, ~ leaf_age))

```
